blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Students, faculty and staff of Xavier University-Ateneo de Cagayan walked out of their classrooms Tuesday and conducted a campus-wide noise barrage. They are protesting the US-led Pax Silica initiative and what is seen as a creeping specter of US imperialism. “This is an important expression of student and youth participation, spearheaded by our Central Student Government,” Nestor Banuag, Jr., director of XU’s Social Involvement and Advocacy Program, told the Inquirer on Wednesday. “It is only right that young people make their voices heard on issues that will significantly shape their future,” Banuag emphasized.
